_comment: Project-scoped MCP config for working ON this repo — NOT the config the Axle plugin ships. That one is generated at packages/clients/axle/.mcp.json by `npm run clients:generate`. This one spawns the SAME bundled server the plugin ships, over stdio, so working on the repo needs no port, no host and no deploy. To develop against a real hub instead, run `npm run dev:hub` and swap this entry for the `local` channel in packages/clients/channels.json (http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp, anonymous).
